note: What a server sends to open a camp of units that belong to no side. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where the camp sits, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: atY
fields.note: Where it sits, in height, in world units.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where it sits, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: campIcon
fields.note: The name of the icon the minimap shows at the camp, written in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above; empty shows none. A client uses it only where it creates the camp.
